profit_quality.assessment: Reported 2025 net profit was HKD 6.572m, but operating profit was only HKD 2.042m and finance income was HKD 5.574m. After removing the benefit of the detachable cash pool, the more relevant cash denominator is 2025 operating cash flow less PPE and intangible purchases, about HKD 0.905m before haircut.
adjustments: Used operating cash flow of HKD 4.561m rather than reported net profit because net profit includes large bank interest income.
Deducted 2025 PPE capex HKD 3.266m and intangible capex HKD 0.390m as a conservative maintenance/reinvestment proxy.
Applied 0.60 profit haircut because 2024 free cash flow after capex was negative, 2025 free cash flow was thin, and revenue is concentrated in a few major customers and export markets.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025/2024/2023 operating cash flows were HKD 4.561m, HKD 6.878m and HKD 18.385m; after PPE plus intangible capex, free cash flows were HKD 0.905m, negative HKD 0.432m and HKD 14.778m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is positive in 2025 but low after capex, and reported profit materially depends on interest earned from the cash pool that is being treated as detachable.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2025 operating cash flow was about 69.4% of reported net profit; free cash flow after capex was only about 13.8% of reported net profit.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No precise maintenance/growth split was disclosed; total PPE and intangible purchases of HKD 3.656m were used conservatively.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working capital changes consumed cash: trade receivables increased HKD 4.214m and contract-related liabilities decreased HKD 4.314m.
